known_limitations: The Mailbox Operations Center is read-only and advisory; it summarizes existing artifacts and does not mark messages read or acknowledged.
Unread counts are derived from open/unresolved message state because no separate safe read-state authority exists in the current mailbox artifacts.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
summary: Added a read-only Mailbox Operations Center tab to the Office of the Steward that summarizes mailbox index, mailbox synchronization, Check for Updates, Communication Bus, worker inbox, personnel, and mailbox registry artifacts; surfaces open/unread, acknowledgement-required, Steward-waiting, unresolved destination warning, and last synchronization counts; and keeps details collapsed by default with status bar mailbox counts preserved.
